sources.subject: Can Your IRA Own a Rental Property?
headlines: Smart Money Trivia
Smart Money Trivia — Answer
Your starting point
You need an IRA that permits property investments. A self-directed IRA with a custodian that handles real estate can hold investment property.
You can’t make yourself at home.
The rent, and the repair bills, belong to the IRA. Rental income goes into the account, and property expenses must be paid from IRA funds.
